description.value: The Hotel at River Rock is an 11-storey full-service hotel attached to the River Rock Casino Resort on the Fraser River in Richmond, operated by Great Canadian Entertainment. It markets itself as a destination for romantic getaways, business travel, and weekend breaks, with the casino, restaurants, and live entertainment on site. Touring cyclists would find it a sizeable urban hotel with easy access to the River Road cycling corridor along the Fraser.
